scope: Windows 11 x64. Disposable local directories, generated loopback SFTP service, native MSVC/Tauri/WebView2 desktop; browser UI mocks used for delayed IPC and host/tab-switch races.
feature: A09: an authenticated SSH tab can show local and remote folders side by side, preview both, and enqueue reviewed uploads and downloads.
verified: Native transfer through the displayed controls uploaded a file and directory tree, preserved an empty directory and the exact UTF-8 content, and refreshed the remote list. Cancelling the download review created no file; confirmation downloaded into the displayed local destination and refreshed its listing.

Native local and remote same.txt previews displayed different original text, including literal HTML markup on the local side. A multibyte UTF-8 sequence cut at 64 KiB remained well-formed. Changing local directory left the remote preview open. Side-by-side geometry and both scroll regions passed at 960x560 and 1280x800.

Browser checks on an SFTP-only session covered 100-row pagination, link exclusion, Shift selection after filtering on both sides, local navigation superseding a delayed listing and selection changes invalidating a delayed preview. Switching hosts during preparation left the second tab blank and suppressed the old review. Opening a separate local file tab did not change the original remote path.

Regression coverage included single-pane picker transfers, reconnect, no-overwrite, partial files, queue recovery after ordinary close and process kill, M1-M4 Harness workspace isolation, browser references and three loopback API formats.
limits: Pane previews display at most 64 KiB of ordinary text per side.
The local folder choice belongs to the current authenticated tab and resets on a new login.
Clean Windows 10/11 release acceptance and authenticated production-provider verification are separate gates.
